== Course of events ==

The proposal came after the Scarecrow's mice had sent the Army of Revolt and Jinjur fleeing the palace in panic, and after Nick Chopper, wielding his axe, had frightened off the Army of Revolt's guards so that the travelers entered the Emerald City unopposed. Having watched men doing housework while the women who staged the revolution gossiped and laughed, the Scarecrow had grown suspicious of how easily the group had progressed toward the palace, and sat thinking quietly before speaking.

After this quiet thought, the Scarecrow proposed building a flying machine on the roof and using the Powder of Life to animate it, naming Nick Chopper as the one to build it.

What followed the proposal was the Scarecrow turning to the question of the palace itself: he argued that Jinjur was rightfully Queen and that the group had no claim to occupy her palace, declared that they could not stay shut inside it and called for a plan of escape, and then removed his own crown, setting it aside and reflecting that Jinjur might now claim it.
